description: Follow Estonia's electricity and gas grid with Elering, its transmission system operator. Get Nord Pool day-ahead prices for Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania and Finland, the price now and tomorrow's prices, and find the cheapest hours to use power. See Estonia's production, consumption, wind and solar output and the plan ahead, flows and trade with Finland and Latvia, and the monthly balance; and gas flows, prices, quality, capacity and nominations. Start workflows when tomorrow's prices are out or the price crosses a level. No account or API key required.

elering_price_crossed_trigger.description: Runs when the day-ahead electricity price of the quarter hour starting now falls below or rises above a level you set, once per crossing, with the price and when the published prices cross back.

output.time: When this price started, ISO 8601 UTC.
output.until: When the published prices cross back, ISO 8601 UTC; empty when every price published so far stays on this side.
